posts.text: Hi… Aayush What i understand is, 70% YoY guidance for FY27 is including revenue from Sojern Division… while 15-20% organic means, revenue growth ex-sojern for FY27 over FY26. In FY26, revenue ex-Sojern was ~1170Cr & revenue from Sojern ~650Cr. So as per my understanding, mgmt is implying 1350-1400Cr revenue ex-Sojern in FY27 & ~1700cr from Sojern. Thanx…
